review: Root independently read complete new observer implementation and all new tests, original-worker diff, and docs. Recomputed exact eight-segment inverse against base Git blob. No blocker found.
boundaries: Only explicit Stop and actual authority-revocation handlers record cause after original intake.stop; error cleanup has no cause.
Observed wrapper records actual Ready Result and returns the same object. Body future is dropped before the guard publishes drop; drop does not classify task outcome.
Atomic packed-state read and double fault check give bounded historical observations, no progress/health lease. Single CAS refuses concurrent publication without retry.
Real-worker factory preserves production/default clocks/options/select budgets and original shutdown returns; production only adds a transparent shared-body wrapper.
New real-channel tests causally withhold completion and send Stop after actual16th receive; no kernel17-datagram assumption. Cancellation and panic use real awaited JoinHandles.
Tests do not establish private connector task join, Actor/service exit, polling rounds or clock admission; original123 migration remains separate.
executable_gates: First independent gates in progress; this review is source evidence only.
